Cold-Chain Shipping Validation Report -- Consignment Batch Q3-2091

This report documents temperature, humidity, and transit compliance for two consignments shipped under validated cold-chain protocols during the third quarter monitoring cycle.

Lot 7734 (Refrigerated Vaccine Shipment)
Lot 7734 must be maintained within a storage temperature limit of 2 to 8 degrees Celsius throughout transit. Equivalently, the approved storage temperature limit for Lot 7734 is 36 to 46 degrees Fahrenheit. The validated excursion allowance above the upper threshold for Lot 7734 is 4 hours before the shipment is considered non-compliant. Data-logger review recorded a mean kinetic temperature of 5.6 degrees Celsius for Lot 7734 across the full transit window. The relative humidity recorded during transit for Lot 7734 was 45 percent. Total transit duration for Lot 7734 was 18 hours from dock release to receiving-site check-in. The low alarm set-point configured on the Lot 7734 data logger is 1 degree Celsius. Lot 7734 was carried by TempGuard Logistics for the entirety of the route.

Lot 2201 (Frozen Biologic Shipment)
Lot 2201 requires deep-frozen handling with a maximum storage temperature limit of -15 degrees Celsius. In Fahrenheit terms, the maximum storage temperature limit for Lot 2201 is 5 degrees Fahrenheit, a figure that does not scale linearly from the Celsius figure given the offset between the two scales. The excursion allowance above threshold approved for Lot 2201 is 2 hours, tighter than the refrigerated lane because frozen biologic material degrades faster once warmed. Mean kinetic temperature analysis of the Lot 2201 logger trace yielded -17.2 degrees Celsius for the shipment. Relative humidity during transit for Lot 2201 was measured at 30 percent inside the insulated container. Lot 2201 spent 26 hours in transit from the origin freezer facility to the destination cold room. The low alarm set-point on the Lot 2201 logger is set to -25 degrees Celsius, well below the freezing point of water, to catch any dangerous downward excursion early. Lot 2201 was carried by Arctic Freight Solutions under a dedicated frozen-lane contract.

Both lots passed final validation review, though the frozen lane's tighter excursion allowance reflects the higher sensitivity of the biologic payload to any thaw event.
